notes: Every requirements document with at least one requirement whose `Verified by:` field names the permission-matrix spec. Documents that cite the spec in the test plan or in prose are out; only a Verified by claim counts, which is what makes this mechanically checkable against the documents rather than a judgement about coverage. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts from corpus/taskflow/docs/** using the same two conventions scripts/check-docs-corpus.ts enforces (a heading whose text starts with an id DEFINES it; a backticked src/tests/scripts path is a code citation); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. The aggregator documents traceability.md, glossary.md and every index.md are excluded from doc keys: they are generated from, or index, the whole corpus, so they cite nearly every id and path and would appear in every answer regardless of the question.
